    if (isLoading || newValue == '') {
        return;
    }
    // Get Source and Destination
    var source = g_form.getValue('starting_from');
    var destination = g_form.getValue('going_to');

    // Passenger Count
    var numPassengers = Number(newValue);

    // Get Journey Type
    var journeyType = g_form.getValue('type_of_journey');

    // Ameerpet → Madhapur
    if (source == '4c2699b7c3c34710d882d54d0501316b' &&
        destination == '88f59533c3c34710d882d54d05013145') {

        if (journeyType == '1') {

            // ₹30 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 30
            );

            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');

        } else if (journeyType == '2') {

            // ₹60 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');

            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 60
            );
        }
    }
    // Ameerpet → LB Nagar
    else if (source == '4c2699b7c3c34710d882d54d0501316b' &&
        destination == '4456193fc3834710d882d54d05013180') {
        if (journeyType == '1') {
            // ₹50 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 50
            );
            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        } else if (journeyType == '2') {
            // ₹100 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 100
            );
        }
    }
    // Ameerpet → Kukatpally
    else if (source == '4c2699b7c3c34710d882d54d0501316b' &&
        destination == '7cc5dd77c3c34710d882d54d05013196') {
        if (journeyType == '1') {
            // ₹30 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 30
            );
            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        } else if (journeyType == '2') {
            // ₹60 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 60
            );
        }
    }
    // Ameerpet → Jubilee Hills
    else if (source == '4c2699b7c3c34710d882d54d0501316b' &&
        destination == '88f59533c3c34710d882d54d05013145') {
        if (journeyType == '1') {
            // ₹20 per passenger
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_for_single_journey',
                numPassengers * 20
            );
            g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
        } else if (journeyType == '2') {
            // ₹40 per passenger
            g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
            g_form.setValue(
                'amount_including_return',
                numPassengers * 40
            );
        }
    } else {
        // Clear amounts if no route matches
        g_form.clearValue('amount_for_single_journey');
        g_form.clearValue('amount_including_return');
    }
}]]></script><sys_class_name>catalog_script_client</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-08 12:41:15</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>f2498ec0c35bc710d882d54d050131a5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Fare auto - Calculation</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>catalog_script_client_f2498ec0c35bc710d882d54d050131a5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-08 12:41:47</sys_updated_on><table/><type>onChange</type><ui_type>0</ui_type><va_supported>true</va_supported><variable_set/><view/></catalog_script_client></record_update>
